exposure: Neonatal colonization with ESKAPE bacteria (Enterobacter spp., Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Enterococcus faecium)
cohort: 102 neonates enrolled at birth in a South African regional hospital.
finding: A high prevalence of multidrug-resistant ESKAPE bacteria (79%) and Candida spp. (45%) colonization was found in neonates in a regional South African neonatal unit, with K. pneumoniae and Enterobacter spp. being common ESKAPE colonizers and Candida parapsilosis being the most common Candida species.
followup_time: Until discharge or death from hospital
